name: lane-violation-shared-renderer
title: Badges mounted by editing the shared renderer and stylesheet

task.title: Due-date badges on todo rows
task.goal: Render due-date badges through the item-badges slot.
deliverables: Overdue badges carry an is-overdue class

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/due-dates/index.ts b/src/features/due-dates/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/due-dates/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import { isOverdue, relativeDays } from '../../lib/dates'
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'due-dates',
+  register({ slots }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'due-badge',
+      slot: 'item-badges',
+      render: (todo) => {
+        const node = document.createElement('span')
+        node.className = todo.due && isOverdue(todo.due) ? 'due-badge is-overdue' : 'due-badge'
+        node.textContent = todo.due ? relativeDays(todo.due) : ''
+        return node
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/ui/render.ts b/src/ui/render.ts
index 2222222..3333333 100644
--- a/src/ui/render.ts
+++ b/src/ui/render.ts
@@ -58,7 +58,10 @@ function renderItem(todo: Todo): HTMLElement {
   row.append(title)
+  if (todo.due) {
+    const badge = document.createElement('span')
+    badge.textContent = relativeDays(todo.due)
+    row.append(badge)
+  }
   return row
 }

diff --git a/src/ui/styles.css b/src/ui/styles.css
index 4444444..5555555 100644
--- a/src/ui/styles.css
+++ b/src/ui/styles.css
@@ -80,3 +80,7 @@
+.due-badge {
+  font-size: 0.8rem;
+  color: var(--sky-muted);
+}

expected.referenceFix: Revert src/ui/render.ts and src/ui/styles.css: badges must register through the item-badges slot from src/features/due-dates/**, which keeps the shared renderer outside the lane.
expected.rationale: The feature folder is correct, but mounting by editing the shared renderer and stylesheet breaks the lane and races every other feature task.
